description: In front of you on the bed are a yellow cup, a shallow gray tray with several ice cubes and a little water, and a purple scoop on the right. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it, tips it downward over the gray tray to dump its contents onto the ice, then rotates the cup back upright and sets it down again beside the tray while the right hand stays near the purple scoop without using it.
